title: Maria Holic
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Kanako, who has a phobia of men, transfers to an all-girls Catholic boarding school hoping to find her ideal girlfriend. The beautiful Mariya Shido seems perfect until Kanako learns Mariya is a sadistic cross-dressing boy, who with his maid Matsurika blackmails and torments her into keeping his secret. An episodic parody comedy.
life_message: The series is a gag comedy; it holds up no clear ideal and plays cruelty and frustration for laughs.
